## 💬 Code Snippets

```java
// Minecraft plugin event handler example
@EventHandler
public void onPlayerJoin(PlayerJoinEvent event) {
    Player player = event.getPlayer();
    player.sendMessage(ChatColor.LIGHT_PURPLE + "✨ Welcome to the server, " + player.getName() + "! ✨");
    
    // Apply custom effects
    player.addPotionEffect(new PotionEffect(PotionEffectType.SPEED, 200, 1));
    
    // Play custom sound
    player.playSound(player.getLocation(), Sound.ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP, 1.0F, 1.0F);
}
```

```java
// Custom item creation in Minecraft
public ItemStack createMagicWand() {
    ItemStack wand = new ItemStack(Material.BLAZE_ROD, 1);
    ItemMeta meta = wand.getItemMeta();
    
    meta.setDisplayName(ChatColor.LIGHT_PURPLE + "✨ Magic Wand ✨");
    
    List<String> lore = new ArrayList<>();
    lore.add(ChatColor.ITALIC + "A wand infused with magical energy");
    lore.add(ChatColor.BLUE + "Right-click to cast a spell");
    meta.setLore(lore);
    
    meta.addEnchant(Enchantment.LUCK, 1, true);
    meta.addItemFlags(ItemFlag.HIDE_ENCHANTS);
    
    wand.setItemMeta(meta);
    return wand;
}
```
